desc: Ideation: identify KMP automaton with backward feasibility and greedy reconstruction as the primary approach.

Implement the full KMP position-dependent automaton solution in the starter code: build the prefix function, O(m*26) transition table with full-match fallback, none/T/F next-state bit masks, backward bitset feasibility DP, and greedy lexicographic reconstruction.
Validate with examples, edge cases (m = 1, all T, all F, impossible overlapping T constraints), and small brute-force/random tests for lexicographic minimality.
